0022600113.text: The Pacers (1-1, third in the Central and 9th in the East) visit the Nets (0-1, fourth in the Atlantic and 10th in the East) in Indiana's third game of the season, coming off a loss and sitting at 1-0 on the road. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is missing Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder). Indiana won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 123-94 win in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026, and the 2026-27 series has no games yet.
